entries.title: Undergraduate Researcher, Semiconductor Nanofabrication
entries.org: Pulsed Laser Template Engineering (PLATEN) Lab, University of Oklahoma
entries.body: Cleanroom fabrication of high-aspect-ratio micro- and nanostructures.
entries.mediaAlt: Sample wafer after photolithography and plasma etching in the cleanroom.
bullets: Fabricate high-aspect-ratio micro- and nanostructures using photolithography, reactive ion etching and pulsed laser deposition.
Independently own the pulsed laser deposition step, growing LAO films on STO substrates and monitoring growth with reflection high-energy electron diffraction (RHEED).
Optimize anisotropic plasma etch parameters (gas chemistry, RF power, chamber pressure) and mask selectivity for vertical sidewalls and controlled depth.

entries.title: Electrical Systems Engineer, Power Distribution
entries.body: Hub board for SCR's IGVC 2027 robot.
bullets: Designed a 4-layer power, CAN and E-Stop distribution PCB in Altium, routing 12 V at up to 10 A to 7 ports with INA220 current sensing.
Replaced the team-standard Schottky with P-MOSFET reverse-polarity protection, cutting calculated loss at 8 A from 3.6 W to 0.7 W.
Selected the 3.3 V buck converter and proposed an STM32C092 with CAN to reuse last year's firmware.
entries.mediaAlt: Hub block diagram: 12 V power in, fused and current-sensed out to 7 ports, with CAN and a hardware E-Stop to each.

entries.title: Peer Learning Assistant
entries.org: Student Learning Center, University of Oklahoma
entries.body: Tutoring in core math and science courses at OU's Student Learning Center.
bullets: Mentor 250+ students per semester in Physics I–II, Calculus I–III and General Chemistry I.
Teach structured, step-by-step problem-solving methods that students can repeat on their own.

entries.title: Undergraduate Researcher, Optical Characterization (Dr. Tischler)
entries.org: Light–Matter Interaction Lab, University of Oklahoma
entries.body: Optical characterization of silicon carbide nanocrystals.
bullets: Characterized silicon carbide nanocrystals by Raman spectroscopy, aligning the benchtop optical setup and collecting spectra to assess crystal structure and material quality.

entries.title: Undergraduate Researcher, Data Analysis (Dr. McFarquhar)
entries.org: National Weather Center, University of Oklahoma
entries.body: First Year Research Experience with the cloud microphysics group.
entries.mediaAlt: Research poster on Arctic cloud microphysics from the CAESAR campaign
bullets: Analyzed NSF/NCAR C-130 data from the CAESAR campaign to see how cloud properties change with altitude.
Compared water content, particle size and condensation-nuclei concentration from several probes against normalized cloud height.
Processed and plotted the data in Python (NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib) for a research poster.
